outline:
本課程包括：海洋、海岸的地質作用、地震、地球的內部、地殼 變動、大陸和山脈、能源和能源礦產、地球的資源、板塊構造學說 、地球和太陽系等。
Geology is a study of the planet Earth. It is concerned with the origin of the planet, the material and morphology of the Earth, and its history and present forms. Geology(2) include : coastal scenery and the work of the sea, marine sediments and the ocean floor, earthquakes, plate tectonic, mineral resources, etc.

02 岩石如何變形How Rock Bends,Buckles and Breaks
03 岩石如何變形How Rock Bends,Buckles and Breaks
04 地震與地球內部Earthquakes and Earth’s Interior
05 地震與地球內部Earthquakes and Earth’s Interior
06 地質年代與岩石記錄Geologic Time and the Rock Record
07 地質年代與岩石記錄Geologic Time and the Rock Record
08 複習Review
09 期中考試並決定預警名單
10 大地變化的面貌The Changing Face of the Land
11 塊體損耗Mass Wasting
12 河流與流域系統Streams and Drainage System
13 地下水Groundwater
14 冰河與冰河作用Glaciers and Glaciation
